name: label-image-mcp
description: Image Annotation, including Histopathology slides; From H&E slide to training data in one conversation: nuclei, outlines and slide QC, exported to QuPath, COCO or YOLO. No GPU needed.
long_description: Lets Claude list, upload and describe images saved in Image Label (labels.sachin-kale.com), add or clean up annotations, and export training data: COCO JSON, YOLO labels, YOLO classes or QuPath GeoJSON. Needs an Image Label account to upload or save annotations.

username.title: Username
username.description: Image Label account username. Leave empty for read-only access.

api_url.title: API URL
api_url.description: Only change this to use a different deployment

tools.name: list_images
tools.description: List saved images, optionally filtered by category

tools.name: get_image
tools.description: Get an image's metadata, annotations and viewing URL

tools.name: view_image
tools.description: See an image with a pixel grid, optionally with its annotations drawn on or zoomed into a region

tools.name: update_image_metadata
tools.description: Update an image's name, category or description

tools.name: add_annotations
tools.description: Append annotations to an image

tools.name: replace_annotations
tools.description: Replace all annotations on an image

tools.name: remove_annotations
tools.description: Remove annotations by id

tools.name: upload_image
tools.description: Upload a local image file

tools.name: upload_image_from_url
tools.description: Download an image from an https URL and upload it to Image Label

tools.name: segment_objects
tools.description: Trace precise outlines with Segment Anything (SAM, or MedSAM for medical images) from rough boxes or points, and save them as polygons

tools.name: detect_nuclei
tools.description: Find and outline every cell nucleus in an H&E histology image with StarDist, marking enlarged nuclei

tools.name: classify_cells
tools.description: Classify detected nuclei as tumour, immune, connective tissue, dead or normal epithelial cells (HoVer-Net, research and education only)

tools.name: normalize_stain
tools.description: Standardise an H&E image's colours (Macenko stain normalization), saved as a new image

tools.name: check_image_quality
tools.description: HistoQC-style checks of a histology image: tissue, blur, marker pen, exposure, faint staining

tools.name: warm_up
tools.description: Start loading a model (SAM, MedSAM or the nuclei model) ahead of use

tools.name: analyze_slide
tools.description: Analyse a whole slide in the background: tissue tiles, quality, nuclei per mm², nuclear size and enlarged nuclei

tools.name: get_slide_analysis
tools.description: A whole slide's analysis status and results, with the densest tiles and every nucleus as QuPath GeoJSON

tools.name: upload_slide
tools.description: Upload a whole-slide file (SVS, NDPI, pyramidal TIFF, up to 5 GB) and start its analysis

tools.name: upload_slide_from_url
tools.description: Copy a whole-slide file from an https URL and start its analysis

tools.name: export_annotations
tools.description: Export annotations as COCO JSON, YOLO or QuPath GeoJSON

tools.name: export_dataset
tools.description: Export many images as one COCO, YOLO or QuPath dataset with one class list

prompts.name: analyse_slide
prompts.description: Quality check, nuclei and a look at the result for one H&E image
prompts.text: Analyse the H&E histology image ${arguments.image}: check its quality, detect nuclei (microns_per_pixel ${arguments.microns_per_pixel}), view the result and summarise it.

prompts.name: outline_objects
prompts.description: Outline named objects with Segment Anything, checking the result
prompts.text: Outline ${arguments.objects} in the image ${arguments.image}: view it, segment each object from a rough box, and check the outlines.

prompts.name: build_training_dataset
prompts.description: Check a category's labels and export it as one dataset
prompts.text: Build a ${arguments.format} training dataset from the images in category ${arguments.category}, after checking for inconsistent labels.
